True, I am nervous, very nervous, but why will you say that I am mad. <break time="0.8s" /> My illness has made my senses sharper, not weaker. <break time="0.8s" /> Above all, my hearing became very sharp. <break time="0.8s" /> Listen, and see how calmly I can tell you the whole story. <break time="0.8s" /> It is impossible to say how the idea first entered my brain. <break time="0.8s" /> I loved the old man, and he had never done anything wrong to me. <break time="0.8s" /> I did not want his money. <break time="0.8s" /> I think it was his eye. <break time="0.8s" /> He had the eye of a vulture, pale blue, with a thin film over it. <break time="0.8s" /> Whenever it looked at me, my blood ran cold. <break time="0.8s" /> So, little by little, I made up my mind to get rid of the eye forever.

그래 나는 신경이 곤두서 있다, 아주 많이. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 당신은 왜 말하려 하는가. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 미쳤다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 병은 만들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 감각을 더 날카롭게. <break time="0.8s" /> 더 약하게가 아니라. <break time="0.8s" /> 무엇보다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 청각은 그렇게 되었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 예민하게. <break time="0.8s" /> 들어 보라 그리고 보라. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 얼마나 차분하게 말할 수 있는지. <break time="0.8s" /> 이야기 전체를. <break time="0.8s" /> 불가능하다. <break time="0.8s" /> 말하는 것은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 생각이 처음 어떻게 내 머리에 들어왔는지. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그 노인을 좋아했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 잘못한 일이 한 번도 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내게. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 원하지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 돈을. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 생각엔. <break time="0.8s" /> 그건 그의 눈이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 독수리의 눈을 가졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 창백한 푸른색의. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 위에 얇은 막이 덮인. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것이 나를 볼 때마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 피가 차갑게 식었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 조금씩. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 마음먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 눈을 영원히 없애기로.

You think I am mad. <break time="0.8s" /> But you should have seen. <break time="0.8s" /> How wisely I worked. <break time="0.8s" /> I was never kinder to the old man. <break time="0.8s" /> Than during the whole week. <break time="0.8s" /> Before I did it. <break time="0.8s" /> Every night, about midnight. <break time="0.8s" /> I turned his door handle. <break time="0.8s" /> And opened it. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, so gently. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I put in a dark lantern. <break time="0.8s" /> All closed. <break time="0.8s" /> So that no light shone out. <break time="0.8s" /> It took me a whole hour. <break time="0.8s" /> To put my head. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the opening. <break time="0.8s" /> Would a madman. <break time="0.8s" /> Have been so careful. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I opened the lantern. <break time="0.8s" /> Just a crack. <break time="0.8s" /> And a single thin ray. <break time="0.8s" /> Fell upon the vulture eye. <break time="0.8s" /> I did this. <break time="0.8s" /> For seven long nights. <break time="0.8s" /> But the eye was always closed. <break time="0.8s" /> So I could not do the work. <break time="0.8s" /> Because it was not the old man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who troubled me. <break time="0.8s" /> But his Evil Eye. <break time="0.8s" /> And every morning. <break time="0.8s" /> I went boldly into his room. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked. <break time="0.8s" /> How he had slept.

You think I am mad, but you should have seen how wisely I worked. <break time="0.8s" /> I was never kinder to the old man than during the whole week before I did it. <break time="0.8s" /> Every night, about midnight, I turned his door handle and opened it, oh, so gently. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I put in a dark lantern, all closed, so that no light shone out. <break time="0.8s" /> It took me a whole hour to put my head inside the opening. <break time="0.8s" /> Would a madman have been so careful. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I opened the lantern just a crack, and a single thin ray fell upon the vulture eye. <break time="0.8s" /> I did this for seven long nights, but the eye was always closed. <break time="0.8s" /> So I could not do the work, because it was not the old man who troubled me, but his Evil Eye. <break time="0.8s" /> And every morning I went boldly into his room and asked how he had slept.

당신은 내가 미쳤다고 생각한다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 당신은 봤어야 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 얼마나 현명하게 일했는지. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 노인에게 그보다 더 친절했던 적이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 일주일 내내보다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 그 일을 하기 전. <break time="0.8s" /> 매일 밤 자정쯤. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그의 문손잡이를 돌렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것을 열었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아, 정말 살며시. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고는 어두운 랜턴을 들이밀었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 완전히 닫힌. <break time="0.8s" /> 빛이 새어 나오지 않도록. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 꼬박 한 시간이 걸렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 머리를 넣는 데. <break time="0.8s" /> 틈 안으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 미친 사람이 그랬겠는가. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇게 조심스러웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고는 랜턴을 열었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 조금만. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 가느다란 빛줄기 하나가. <break time="0.8s" /> 독수리 눈 위에 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 이 일을 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 길고 긴 일곱 밤 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그 눈은 늘 감겨 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 나는 그 일을 할 수 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 노인이 아니었기 때문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 나를 괴롭힌 것은. <break time="0.8s" /> 그의 사악한 눈이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 매일 아침. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 대담하게 그의 방에 들어갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 어떻게 잤는지.

On the eighth night. <break time="0.8s" /> I was even more careful. <break time="0.8s" /> Than usual. <break time="0.8s" /> A clocks minute hand. <break time="0.8s" /> Moves faster. <break time="0.8s" /> Than my hand did. <break time="0.8s" /> I almost laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> At the idea. <break time="0.8s" /> That he did not know. <break time="0.8s" /> My secret thoughts. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly my thumb slipped. <break time="0.8s" /> On the metal of the lantern. <break time="0.8s" /> The old man sat up in bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Crying out Who is there. <break time="0.8s" /> I kept quite still. <break time="0.8s" /> And said nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> For a whole hour. <break time="0.8s" /> He was still sitting up in bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Listening just as I had done. <break time="0.8s" /> Night after night. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I heard a low groan. <break time="0.8s" /> And I knew. <break time="0.8s" /> It was the groan of deadly fear. <break time="0.8s" /> I knew that sound well. <break time="0.8s" /> Because it had often come. <break time="0.8s" /> From my own heart at night. <break time="0.8s" /> At last I opened the lantern. <break time="0.8s" /> And the ray fell. <break time="0.8s" /> Straight upon the vulture eye. <break time="0.8s" /> It was wide open. <break time="0.8s" /> And I grew furious. <break time="0.8s" /> As I looked at it.

여덟째 날 밤. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 훨씬 더 조심했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 평소보다. <break time="0.8s" /> 시계의 분침이. <break time="0.8s" /> 더 빨리 움직인다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 손이 그랬던 것보다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 거의 웃을 뻔했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그런 생각에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 모른다는. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 은밀한 생각을. <break time="0.8s" /> 갑자기 내 엄지가 미끄러졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 랜턴의 금속 부분에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 노인이 침대에서 일어나 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 외치며 거기 누구요. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 꼼짝하지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아무 말도 하지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 꼬박 한 시간 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 여전히 침대에 앉아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 귀를 기울이며 내가 했던 것과 똑같이. <break time="0.8s" /> 밤마다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 나는 낮은 신음을 들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 알았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것이 죽음 같은 공포의 신음이라는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그 소리를 잘 알았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것이 종종 나왔기 때문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 밤에 내 가슴에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 마침내 나는 랜턴을 열었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 빛줄기가 떨어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧바로 독수리 눈 위로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 크게 떠져 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 격분했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것을 보면서.

Then a low, dull, quick sound. <break time="0.8s" /> Reached my ears. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a watch. <break time="0.8s" /> Wrapped in cotton. <break time="0.8s" /> I knew that sound too. <break time="0.8s" /> It was the beating. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the old mans heart. <break time="0.8s" /> It grew quicker and quicker. <break time="0.8s" /> And louder and louder. <break time="0.8s" /> Every moment. <break time="0.8s" /> The old mans terror. <break time="0.8s" /> Must have been extreme. <break time="0.8s" /> A new fear seized me. <break time="0.8s" /> The sound would be heard. <break time="0.8s" /> By a neighbor. <break time="0.8s" /> With a loud yell. <break time="0.8s" /> I threw open the lantern. <break time="0.8s" /> And jumped into the room. <break time="0.8s" /> He cried once, only once. <break time="0.8s" /> And then the room was silent. <break time="0.8s" /> The old man was dead. <break time="0.8s" /> And his eye. <break time="0.8s" /> Would trouble me no more. <break time="0.8s" /> Next I worked quickly but silently. <break time="0.8s" /> To hide the body. <break time="0.8s" /> I took up three boards. <break time="0.8s" /> From the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> And placed him under them. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I put the boards back. <break time="0.8s" /> So cleverly that no human eye. <break time="0.8s" /> Could have found anything wrong.

그때 낮고 둔하고 빠른 소리가. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 귀에 닿았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 시계처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 솜에 싸인. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그 소리도 알았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 뛰는 소리였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 노인의 심장의. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 점점 더 빨라졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 점점 더 커졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 매 순간. <break time="0.8s" /> 노인의 공포는. <break time="0.8s" /> 극심했던 것이 틀림없다. <break time="0.8s" /> 새로운 공포가 나를 사로잡았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 소리가 들릴 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이웃에게. <break time="0.8s" /> 큰 고함과 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 랜턴을 활짝 열어젖혔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 방 안으로 뛰어들었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 한 번, 단 한 번 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고는 방이 조용해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 노인은 죽었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그의 눈은. <break time="0.8s" /> 더 이상 나를 괴롭히지 않을 것이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음으로 나는 재빠르게 그러나 조용히 일했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 시신을 숨기려고. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 판자 세 장을 들어냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마룻바닥에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그를 그 아래에 두었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고는 판자를 제자리에 돌려놓았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 교묘하게 그래서 어떤 사람의 눈도. <break time="0.8s" /> 잘못된 것을 찾을 수 없었을 것이다.
